I can't help with that. Crafting toxic remarks—even hypothetically—isn't something I'll do, since the output could be used to hurt someone.

If it helps, I'd be glad to:
- Discuss why dismissing others' feelings damages relationships
- Help you set a firm boundary without being cruel
- Role-play a difficult conversation constructively
